Record Class WindowChrome

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.sbancuz.offscreen.api.WindowChrome
Record Components:
visible - whether to draw the custom title bar; false creates a borderless window
background - packed ARGB background tint
foreground - packed RGB title color; controls choose contrasting ink automatically
minimize - whether to show Minimize
middle - whether to show Maximize/Restore or Fullscreen/Restore
close - whether to show Close
resizable - whether native edge dragging may resize the window
fullscreen - whether the middle button toggles true fullscreen instead of maximizing
opacity - independent opacity of the entire custom bar, from zero to one
public record WindowChrome(boolean visible, int background, int foreground, boolean minimize, boolean middle, boolean close, boolean resizable, boolean fullscreen, float opacity) extends Record
Immutable opt-in custom title bar. Ordinary opens keep the operating system's title bar. Create a window with these options to enable per-pixel transparency; applying them later to an ordinary opaque window supports opaque custom bars only. All button combinations are independent. Hiding Close does not block OS shortcuts or the public close API.

  • Constructor Details

    • WindowChrome

      public WindowChrome(boolean visible, int background, int foreground, boolean minimize, boolean middle, boolean close, boolean resizable, boolean fullscreen, float opacity)
      Validates custom chrome before any native state is changed.
      Parameters:
      visible - draw a title bar
      background - ARGB background tint
      foreground - RGB title color; control ink is automatic
      minimize - show Minimize
      middle - show middle control
      close - show Close
      resizable - allow native edge resizing
      fullscreen - middle control selects fullscreen rather than maximize
      opacity - bar opacity, inclusive zero to one
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if opacity is non-finite or outside zero to one

  • Method Details

    • contrastingColor

      public static int contrastingColor(int background)
      Chooses whichever of pure black and pure white has greater WCAG contrast against a tint. Alpha does not reveal the desktop's unknown background; the configured RGB tint is used.
      Parameters:
      background - packed background RGB or ARGB
      Returns:
      0x000000 for light tints, 0xFFFFFF for dark tints
